title: Vegan passion fruit curd
creator: spicymoustache
steps: Blend the passion fruit pulp for 30 seconds to free the seeds, then strain (keep a few seeds if you like).
Simmer the juice with the sugar, whisking.
Whisk the milk and cornstarch into a slurry, pour into the pan and cook, whisking, for 3–5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Strain over the cold butter and whisk until silky.
Cover the surface and chill at least 1 hour. Keeps a week in the fridge.
